name: Eastern Polymer Group Public Company Limited
summary: Eastern Polymer Group Public Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and distribution of rubber insulation, automotive, and plastic packing products in Thailand and internationally. The company operates through Rubber Insulation, Automotive Plastics, Packaging Plastics, and Others segments. It manufactures bedliners and covers of pickup trucks; automotive accessories; and rubber for cars, machinery, buildings, and other products.
